Preserved Primary Document • hansr-s1.htm
Around
1849
, she married  Benjamin Durham  and moved to Jolley's Neck Farm. As a Hansor, Sallie Ann was probably descended from William Hansor, the original owner of Jolley's Neck as was her husband Benjamin.

Around 1849, she married Benjamin Durham and moved to Jolley's Neck Farm. As a Hansor, Sallie Ann was probably descended from William Hansor, the original owner of Jolley's Neck as was her husband Benjamin. The known children of Benjamin Durham and Sally Ann Hansor were : Daniel Durham (1849-1931) married Caroline Carney Annie Durham (1855-1912) married John Durhan John M. Durham (1856-1933?) married Elmira Morgan Harriett Durham (1858- d. before 1880) Enoch Durham (1858-1921) married Margaret Munce and Lola Miller Jeremiah Durham (1862-1936) married Lydia Munce Henrietta Durham (1865-1934) married Napoleon B. Sally Ann died on 11 November, 1905. Her death certificate lists her age as 81, her race as Moor and the cause of death as old age & general debility. Both are buried behind the church at Fork Branch, on land that originally belonged to Jolley's Neck.
